text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Start losartan 50 mg daily and raise it to the maximum dose of 100 mg for A2 albuminuria; check potassium and creatinine 2 to 4 weeks after each start or increase, accepting a creatinine rise of up to 30 percent
  • If a second sample confirms a urine albumin-creatinine ratio of at least 200 mg/g, add an SGLT2 inhibitor (dapagliflozin 10 mg daily) after the nephrology review, and check potassium and creatinine 2 to 4 weeks later
  • Stop naproxen and avoid all NSAIDs; acetaminophen for headache; check kidney function before any iodinated contrast; adjust drug doses to eGFR
  • Nephrology consultation to confirm the cause of chronic kidney disease with albuminuria in a woman in her fifties and to advise on treatment and follow-up
  • Sick-day guidance: during vomiting, diarrhea, or poor fluid intake, pause losartan, dapagliflozin, and any other blood pressure medicine, drink fluids, call the clinic, and restart after 24 to 48 hours of normal eating and drinking
  • CMID kidney and blood pressure monitoring: blood pressure every visit with home readings; eGFR and urine albumin twice a year at G3a A2; a metabolic panel with each draw; calcium, phosphate, and PTH every 6 to 12 months; vitamin D at baseline; hemoglobin and KFRE yearly; one lipid panel and a statin; medication review every visit; vaccines reviewed yearly
  • Atorvastatin 20 mg daily; vitamin D3 1,000 units daily with recheck of 25-hydroxyvitamin D, calcium, phosphate, and PTH
  • Vaccines for chronic kidney disease: PCV20 now, a two-dose hepatitis B series, and yearly influenza and COVID-19 vaccines
  • Home-centered care: home visits and video visits with her own validated blood pressure cuff, scale, thermometer, and pulse oximeter; mobile phlebotomy; clinic trips only for tests that need them, with several tasks booked on one quiet early appointment
  • PHQ-9 and GAD-7 at baseline and yearly; her long-standing wish for solitude is respected and not treated as a disorder unless symptoms cause distress or impairment
  • Sodium below 2 g a day, a plant-rich diet, and at least 150 minutes a week of activity, such as garden work and walking

resource.title: Emily Dickinson synthetic care plan
resource.description: Diagnose and manage stage G3a A2 chronic kidney disease with hypertension in a 54-year-old woman by KDIGO 2024 and the CMID kidney and blood pressure schedules: eGFR and albuminuria staging, KFRE, a maximum-dose ARB and an SGLT2 inhibitor with potassium and creatinine checks after each start, a statin, bone-mineral and anemia checks by stage, vaccines, NSAID avoidance, and sick-day guidance, while screening mood and anxiety without labeling a lifelong wish for solitude as a disorder, and delivering care at home or by video where that is safe.
